    | text      = I give it... you don't want it. You don't want it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:02.579
    | text      = It's open.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:05.579
    | text      = So, yeah, I give that a B. That was fine.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:11.579
    | text      = The open food capital of the world.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:16.579
    | text      = In case you get sick from this, the performers have no liability.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:21.579
    | text      = It's not... that's not permission.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:24.579
    | text      = This is Portland. That's not permission to do whatever you want.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:29.579
    | text      = I think it often...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:30.579
    | text      = No, no, no, no. So he stops breathing if you squeeze hard enough.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:33.579
    | text      = This is Portland.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:36.579
    | text      = Them's the rules here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:39.579
    | text      = So, Jordan, today we're here, not just to eat cheese, but also because we have an episode to do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:45.579
    | text      = Indeed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:48.579
    | text      = And there are people here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:50.579
    | text      = Inexplicably.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:51.579
    | text      = And so I would like to open the proceedings by asking you about what kind of relationship you have with music festivals.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:00.579
    | text      = I mean, open, first off.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:03.579
    | text      = I've been to many and we've enjoyed each other's pleasantly and...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:07.579
    | text      = But you're not committed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:08.579
    | text      = Some of them I don't speak to anymore.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:12.579
    | text      = I will say that Jane's addiction is no longer a friend of mine.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:15.579
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:16.579
    | text      = You got to follow me out?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:17.579
    | text      = Yeah, absolutely.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:19.579
    | text      = Did you go to any hippie jam band type of festivals?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:22.579
    | text      = My wife used to go to summer camp all the time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:24.579
    | text      = She used to go to summer camp regularly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:26.579
    | text      = Ooh.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:27.579
    | text      = To the four people who know what that is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:29.579
    | text      = There was half of an applause.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:31.579
    | text      = Yeah, yeah. Summer camp is like the Bonnaroo for shitty Midwestern people in Chillicothe, Illinois.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:39.580
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:40.580
    | text      = So you've heard of it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:42.580
    | text      = Oh, surprising.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:43.580
    | text      = Yeah, just imagine just like hazy smoke and everyone's dirty.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:49.580
    | text      = And one time, one time...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:50.580
    | text      = It's a great time, I guess.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:51.580
    | text      = One time Run the Jewels was there and everybody was like, well, now we have a black friend.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:59.580
    | text      = That translates. Now we're all on the same page.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:02.580
    | text      = Gotcha. Good.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:03.580
    | text      = So, Jordan, August 15th, 1969.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:09.580
    | text      = 5.07 PM.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:11.580
    | text      = Richie Havens takes the stage in a field in New York.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:15.580
    | text      = Kicking off the most culturally defining rock and roll festival of the modern era.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:19.580
    | text      = It was supposed to be Sweetwater that opened the show, but they were late, so Havens got to break in Woodstock.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:25.580
    | text      = He got to break it open.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:27.580
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:28.580
    | text      = Over three days, you had bands like The Band and The Who changing the world with music.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:33.580
    | text      = On August 17th...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:36.580
    | text      = Are we doing a Woodstock recap?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:38.580
    | text      = Yes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:39.580
    | text      = Okay. Now I'm in. I just wanted to be clear, Ken Burns.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:45.580
    | text      = This is going to be that long.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:47.580
    | text      = Okay. No, I'm strapped in.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:50.580
    | text      = On August 17th, Jimi Hendrix closed the festival.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:53.580
    | text      = And his performance of The Star-Spangled Banner has stood as an enduring image in US political history.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:59.580
    | text      = Fun fact, doo-wop throwback act Sha Na Na performed just before Jimi Hendrix, which had to be a crazy vibe shift.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:08.580
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:10.580
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:11.580
    | text      = Sha Na Na opened and closed their set with their hit, Get a Job.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:18.580
    | text      = But because they're going back to the well and doing the same song again, their actual closing song was a cover of Gene Chandler's absurd Duke of Earl.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:33.580
    | text      = Sha Na Na did a cover of Duke of Earl.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:43.580
    | text      = Yeah, that's about how it goes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:46.580
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:47.580
    | text      = So they did that at Woodstock.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:50.580
    | text      = Every time you think, oh, I bet those people were cool. Remember that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:59.580
    | text      = So people did drugs and they fucked in the mud.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:02.580
    | text      = Duke, Duke, Duke, Duke of Earl.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:04.580
    | text      = Listen to Sha Na Na.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:06.580
    | text      = Oh yeah, I can see stars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:08.580
    | text      = Duke, Duke, Duke, Duke of Earl.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:12.580
    | text      = But then it was over, you know, and it wouldn't be long after it ended until folks started to ask, could we do that again?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:20.580
    | text      = Smash cut to May, 1970.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:23.580
    | text      = The Portland Oregonian announces that the American Legion convention would be taking place in the South Park blocks neighborhood of Portland in September.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:31.580
    | text      = And President Richard Nixon would be the special guest.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:37.580
    | text      = It's about time somebody took it to Nixon.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:40.580
    | text      = You guys are on the right side of history.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:42.580
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:44.580
    | text      = Protests against the Vietnam war were at an all time high and Portland's a city with a revolutionary protest.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:49.580
    | text      = Hell yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:50.580
    | text      = Hell yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:54.580
    | text      = The powers that be, including Oregon governor Tom McCall were pretty worried about how Nixon coming to speak at this event was going to be a lightning rod for ne'er do wells.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:03.580
    | text      = The FBI warned that anti-war groups were already planning elaborate disruptions for the convention and hysteria about violence was growing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:11.580
    | text      = The fear was mostly centered around a group called the People's Army Jamboree.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:20.580
    | text      = It's a cool name.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:26.580
    | text      = Squares back then imagined them to be a roving gang of violent hippies who were going to arrive in Portland and burn the city down.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:34.580
    | text      = 20 years later, Reagan did smuggle guns to them though.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:38.580
    | text      = That's how, that's how crazy it is, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:40.580
    | text      = They started out real Jamboree cool and then they're Iran Contra cool.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:44.580
    | text      = So, you know, it changes, things change.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:45.580
    | text      = They were kind of like in a lot of public mind, they were kind of how we treat Antifa now, except the People's Army Jamboree did exist as an organized entity.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:56.580
    | text      = And they had an infrastructure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:58.580
    | text      = Funny story, that infrastructure was facilitated and ultimately destroyed by a $10,000 donation from the heir to the Blue Bell Potato Chip Company.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:08.580
    | text      = Which allowed them to get rent and office, but it also led to huge infighting about who got the chip money.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:13.580
    | text      = Money is the root of all evil, specifically potato chip money.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:18.580
    | text      = So the Jamboree wanted a permit to hold a week long encampment in Washington Park and the city was like, fuck no.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:25.580
    | text      = The city commissioner held the position that they weren't going to be allowed to gather in any public space and they better just go find somewhere to rent.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:34.580
    | text      = So, so essentially we're John Lithgow and this is Flip Loose.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:39.580
    | text      = No dancing in parks.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:41.580
    | text      = No Jamborees.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:43.580
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:45.580
    | text      = So one of the problems that the People's Army Jamboree had was a lack of message discipline.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:50.580
    | text      = I mean a Jamboree is by definition undisciplined.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:54.580
    | text      = Nobody's ever been like, oh, this disciplined Jamboree.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:57.580
    | text      = This is a rigid Jamboree.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:59.580
    | text      = No, yeah, no. This is a very structured Jamboree.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:02.580
    | text      = Yeah. It was a big tent situation in the hippie scene at the time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:06.580
    | text      = On the one hand, you had the resolutely political people who were focused on getting a permit to protest the American Legion convention featuring Richard Nixon.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:14.580
    | text      = On the other hand, you had a bunch of other folks who were out there just trying to have fun and get weird.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:19.580
    | text      = Portland poet and performance artist, Peter Fornara, who's listed as the office manager for the Jamboree on their protest permit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:27.580
    | text      = I'm the office manager for a Jamboree.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:33.580
    | text      = Thanks to the chip money.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:34.580
    | text      = Who's the HR rep for the Jamboree?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:38.580
    | text      = So he was contacted by the media and asked about a rumor that the Jamboree was bringing in 25,000 hippies from around the country to protest.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:48.580
    | text      = Well, you're going to need an office manager for that many hippies.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:51.580
    | text      = That actually makes it, now I know it. I'm right. The bureaucratic is important.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:56.580
    | text      = He told them it was actually 50,000.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:00.580
    | text      = Which led to all of the squares freaking out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:04.580
    | text      = Later Fornara would explain his estimate by saying, quote, we heard the Legion expected to bring 25,000 people to Portland, so we just doubled the number.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:14.580
    | text      = We made it up out of thin air. The number meant nothing. It was just talk.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:20.580
    | text      = But from there it was gospel and it was the image of exactly what the normies were afraid of.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:26.580
    | text      = There was misinformation coming from the FBI and troll shit coming from members of the Jamboree itself and things were getting out of hand.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:34.580
    | text      = Tensions were bubbling and by August things are so crazy that the mayor of Portland, Terry Shrunk, declared an emergency.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:43.580
    | text      = As did Oregon Governor McCall, which included a provision that took the permit for public spaces power away from the city commissioner and he gave it to the mayor.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:52.580
    | text      = Right, right, right. So, importantly, let's just pull back for a second and all of this is because hippies might be coming.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:02.580
    | text      = Yeah, a lot of them. And they're mad at Nixon.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:04.580
    | text      = They might be coming.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:06.580
    | text      = 50,000 hippies vs Nixon?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:09.580
    | text      = You know what, I'm shocked that we have taken a turn toward fascism in this country. It seems crazy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:14.580
    | text      = It seems crazy in retrospect because everybody is so fucking rational all the time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:18.580
    | text      = Yeah, totally. The story only gets less rational.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:22.580
    | text      = Unsurprising.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:24.580
    | text      = So, seeking to find a compromise, Mayor Shrunk allowed a permit for the People's Army Jamboree to use a different park, East Delta Park, to camp and hold workshops at the time of the American Legion convention.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:36.580
    | text      = However, he also gave a permit for the same park to a group called the Free People's Pop Festival, which wanted to do another Woodstock at the same time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:52.580
    | text      = Your mind is putting pieces together, I think.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:55.580
    | text      = You know, sometimes when you look back you go, I can't believe they didn't get their shit together.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:00.580
    | text      = Can't believe we're here where we are now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:02.580
    | text      = So close. They were right there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:04.579
    | text      = In one set of circumstances, this would represent a disaster for the American Legion.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:09.579
    | text      = Now you have the Jamboree being allowed to hold an encampment against their convention in Portland and a potential second Woodstock popping up that's going to draw people from around the country.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:18.579
    | text      = It's a perfect storm.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:20.579
    | text      = Or so it would appear.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:22.579
    | text      = Because none of it is real.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:24.579
    | text      = Because it's all pretend.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:26.579
    | text      = I'll cut to the chase and tell you that the Free People's Pop Festival is irrelevant and it didn't end up happening.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:30.579
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:32.579
    | text      = But keep it in your mind.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:34.579
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:36.579
    | text      = It was supposed to happen at East Delta Park and anti-Legion protests at the same place where they were scheduled to happen.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:39.579
    | text      = At this point, everyone's losing their damn minds.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:42.579
    | text      = The good citizens of Portland are pissed off that the government is making concessions and allowing these hippies to get together.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:47.579
    | text      = And a splinter faction of the People's Army Jamboree are starting to worry that like, are we causing a violent thing?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:55.579
    | text      = Are we going to... are we part of the problem here?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:58.579
    | text      = I want to say that the moment you're in the Jamboree and then you go, we're a splinter faction, you should be like, the Jamboree has gone wrong.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:06.579
    | text      = Once a splinter faction starts, things have already gone too far.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:11.579
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:12.579
    | text      = So one such worried hippie was Sam McNall, who happened to be the son of Oregon Governor Tom McNall.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:18.579
    | text      = Sam had gotten hooked on painkillers at the age of 13 and descended into a bit of a life of crime.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:22.579
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:24.579
    | text      = His family had committed a few times and he was known to hang around at a free clinic in Portland called the Outside Inn, where he would meet...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:31.579
    | text      = He would meet a guy named Charles... Dr. Charles Spray.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:35.579
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:37.579
    | text      = And I only brought him up because I intended to squirt Jordan with a squirt gun.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:39.579
    | text      = That makes sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:40.579
    | text      = I thought I was Charles Spray, but then I bailed on it because I thought it would be me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:43.579
    | text      = Yeah. Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:45.579
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:47.579
    | text      = So Sam and a number of other hippie associates thought that direct confrontation with the American Legion would lead to violence.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:54.579
    | text      = And their hippie ideology was supposed to be about higher vibrations, not lower ones.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:58.579
    | text      = That's not what the Jamboree stands for.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:00.579
    | text      = Nah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:02.579
    | text      = According to this splinter faction, on the other hand...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:04.579
    | text      = The Legion protest had a message that it was all negative.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:07.579
    | text      = Like it's all this stuff we're against.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:09.579
    | text      = Like war.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:11.579
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:13.579
    | text      = Where as they could put on an event that would be free to attend, it would be all about showing that there's a different way of life possible.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:18.579
    | text      = Like war!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:20.579
    | text      = Or fucking in the mud.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:22.579
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:24.579
    | text      = That's kind of against the war.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:26.579
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:28.579
    | text      = So this dream would lead to the creation of the Vortex One Festival.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:31.579
    | text      = Alright.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:33.579
    | text      = Whoever came up with that name won.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:35.579
    | text      = They hoped for another.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:37.579
    | text      = What a great name for the Vortex One. Who are you?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:41.579
    | text      = That's a fucking Top Gun name.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:43.579
    | text      = Vortex One! What are you doing?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:46.579
    | text      = Goose Two.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:48.579
    | text      = Right? What have we got? Oh my god.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:50.579
    | text      = So right about now you might be asking yourself, wasn't there already a permit granted for the Free People's Pop Festival?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:55.579
    | text      = That's actually what I was exactly asking myself.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:57.579
    | text      = And you're right to be confused about that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:59.579
    | text      = I've read a bunch about this and the only conclusion that I can come to for sure is that no one is telling the truth about how this happened.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:08.579
    | text      = Most of the people are self-mythologizing liars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:12.579
    | text      = Sure, sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:14.579
    | text      = The only thing that's certain is that someone came up with a brilliant idea which was for the government to sanction and sponsor a different music festival.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:23.579
    | text      = At the same time somewhere else hoping to lure the hippies away from Portland and from the American Legion convention featuring Richard Nixon.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:40.579
    | text      = You taking it in?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:44.579
    | text      = There's too many hippies coming. What are we gonna do?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:47.579
    | text      = I know. The Music Man!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:49.579
    | text      = We'll get a band together and we'll take them all from one town to the next. We'll just go together.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:59.579
    | text      = And then they're in a different town and we don't have to worry about it anymore.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:03.579
    | text      = If you have enough trombones people will just support the war.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:10.579
    | text      = You win.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:12.579
    | text      = And this is exactly what happened.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:14.579
    | text      = Boom!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:16.579
    | text      = A weird alliance of some concerned Jamboree members, the office of the governor of Oregon and some community organizations threw together Vortex One as an explicit attempt to separate the culture from the counterculture.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:29.579
    | text      = Their hope was to drive a wedge between the serious minded anti-Vietnam protesters and the fun loving music festival lifestyle types.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:37.579
    | text      = Which is a winning strategy that we see undermining protest movements still today.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:41.579
    | text      = Sure, sure, sure, sure. Absolutely.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:43.579
    | text      = So now we have the People's Army Jamboree planning their encampment at East Delta Park.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:48.579
    | text      = And the state of Oregon has given MacIver State Park to the hippies to throw their Vortex One festival.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:53.579
    | text      = Which sucked up all the resources that would have otherwise gone to the Free People's Pop Festival.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:58.579
    | text      = Okay, so here's what brings me to my...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:01.579
    | text      = So there's the Ken Burns explanation of how the Civil War fought and how the military moves around.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:05.579
    | text      = And then there's the community episode where basically Ken Burns explains how people moved their pillow forts around.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:12.579
    | text      = Somehow this is right in between there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:14.579
    | text      = It's both.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:16.579
    | text      = Right? Like this is pillow fort fighting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:18.579
    | text      = But at the same time it's far more real.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:21.579
    | text      = Yeah, you're going to be so disappointed at the end of this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:26.579
    | text      = So at MacIver State Park, which is why I wanted to go out there and we would have probably had it not rained.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:32.579
    | text      = We would have had it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:33.579
    | text      = You could have been there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:35.579
    | text      = But at that park everyone would be allowed to do drugs and be naked.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:39.579
    | text      = And the police had orders not to interfere.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:44.579
    | text      = Boys! We're not going near Fuck Park!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:48.579
    | text      = None of you go near Fuck Park!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:51.579
    | text      = Not you, not you Terry! I know you're going to Fuck Park! Get away from Fuck Park!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:57.579
    | text      = I know you're itching to give out food tickets, but not this weekend.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:03.579
    | text      = You're the only one. Never mind.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:06.579
    | text      = To this location it was chosen strategically because there was only one road in or out of the state park.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:14.579
    | text      = So once the hippies were there the police would have the advantage of probably being able to keep them there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:19.579
    | text      = So now that there's a plan starting to come together, everyone loses their goddamn minds being pulled this way and that way by propaganda.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:28.579
    | text      = The state wants Vortex to be a huge hit, so it'll succeed in luring the hippies away from Portland while Nixon is there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:35.579
    | text      = While it's unclear what role the government had in helping spread these whispers, there were a ton of rumors about huge acts that were going to be there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:43.579
    | text      = They tried to get the message out that this was going to be bigger than Woodstock.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:46.579
    | text      = Like Jefferson Airplane is going to be there. John Lennon is going to come in and do a set.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:52.579
    | text      = You can just make stuff up back then. You can just make it up. Nobody could even look it up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:57.579
    | text      = Everything was the fire festival.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:00.579
    | text      = Every single day you would just go to a fire festival and then it would be like, well you're trapped here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:07.579
    | text      = And you're a slave now I guess. That's America up until the fire festival.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:12.579
    | text      = And you kind of had fun at that disaster of a festival.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:15.579
    | text      = Well what else were you going to do?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:16.579
    | text      = So meanwhile, a rival music festival promoter named Bruce Mackin was trying to stop Vortex from happening because it threatened to destroy his upcoming festival, Bullfrog 4.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:32.579
    | text      = He spread vicious rumors about the Vortex organizers and told the police that their vendors were communist fronts.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:40.579
    | text      = All in an unsuccessful bid to put them out of business.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:44.579
    | text      = While this didn't end up derailing the Vortex festival, it did trickle down to the public in the form of fear.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:51.579
    | text      = So when the time for the festival came around, everyone was on edge.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:55.579
    | text      = Scared as shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:00.579
    | text      = I don't know why we made it this far. I feel like we should all be dead.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:05.579
    | text      = And here's the point where you're really going to be disappointing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:08.579
    | text      = Then nothing happened.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:10.579
    | text      = Oh god. These fucking people man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:12.579
    | text      = At the last minute, Richard Nixon cancelled his speech at the American League of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:20.579
    | text      = Oh my god.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:22.579
    | text      = So that kind of took the wind out of the sails of the Jamboree protests.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:26.579
    | text      = So we're doing the story of the greatest case of blue balls in Oregon history.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:31.579
    | text      = Yes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:33.579
    | text      = The turnout was good at Vortex, but the lineup sucked.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:35.579
    | text      = So it had almost zero cultural impact outside of being the first and almost certainly only hippie music festival officially sponsored by the state government.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:48.579
    | text      = That has never happened and probably never will again.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:52.579
    | text      = In the end, it was mostly just local bands that ended up playing at the festival, but there was one place where Vortex truly did get one up on Woodstock.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:02.579
    | text      = At Woodstock, Shana Na did a cover of Duke of Earl.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:06.579
    | text      = But at Vortex, Duke of Earl did a cover of Shana Na.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:09.579
    | text      = Jean motherfucking Chandler was there!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:12.579
    | text      = Duke, Duke, Duke, Duke of Earl, Duke, Duke, Duke.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:17.579
    | text      = Brought to you by the governor of Oregon.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:20.579
    | text      = Enjoy your fucking and listen to the real Duke of Earl.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:25.579
    | text      = I do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:27.579
    | text      = There is something beautiful because you can always recognize it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:30.579
    | text      = We've all seen it so many times in our life when there was clearly a group of people who didn't have any voice from outside that group of people.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:38.579
    | text      = And at the end of the day, they all went, that's a great idea.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:42.579
    | text      = And if any human being outside of that was like, you're going to set up a rival music festival named Vortex One.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:51.579
    | text      = And you're not going to make a comic book about this?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:54.579
    | text      = Well, then you're an idiot, man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:57.579
    | text      = The market may be open.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:59.579
    | text      = Yeah, absolutely.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:01.579
    | text      = So today we honor this completely absurd piece of Portland history by covering a little bit of the period of time on Alex's show when that festival happened in 2011.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:12.579
    | text      = Yes, absolutely.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:13.579
    | text      = The meteoric trajectory of this tangent has finally landed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:25.579
    | text      = And what I love about it is how from the beginning I know this is going to be so disappointing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:32.579
    | text      = It's eventually going to get there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:34.579
    | text      = It's going to lead to nothing and Nixon cancels.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:36.579
    | text      = Yeah, yeah, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:38.579
    | text      = Like all good spaceship crashes, it went up real high.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:41.579
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:42.579
    | text      = And then it went real low.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:44.579
    | text      = Yeah, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:46.579
    | text      = So you're ready to jump into this episode?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:48.579
    | text      = I suppose.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:50.579
    | text      = Okay, sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:52.579
    | text      = What have we been doing up to this point? Is it a bad question?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:57.579
    | text      = Preamble.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:59.579
    | text      = Ah, I gotcha.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:01.579
    | text      = So here we are. It's August 28th, 2011 when the festival was kicking off.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:07.579
    | text      = Yes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:08.579
    | text      = And here's some big stuff that's going on around this time too.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:11.579
    | text      = This is a monumental little piece of history for him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:16.579
    | text      = Here's why.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:18.579
    | text      = It is Sunday, the 28th day of August, 2011.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:23.579
    | text      = And we're now just, what, four days away from the premiere of InfoWars Nightly News, a completely new media operation.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:32.579
    | text      = Folks know that I'm dedicated, my crew is dedicated, so that's certainly bellying up to the InfoWars Warfare Bar to sign on to produce five TV shows a week.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:45.579
    | text      = You've seen some of the special reports, a lot of production value, a ton of research, hard-hitting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:52.579
    | text      = It's hard-hitting stuff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:54.579
    | text      = We're about to launch the Nightly News.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:56.579
    | text      = Wow.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:28:57.579
    | text      = Sometimes when you know the end of the thing, the beginning of a thing sounds crazy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:05:53.579
    | text      = Alex is talking to this caller and then pulls his dad into the studio.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:06:00.579
    | text      = You know, it's funny. I was talking about my dad just getting back from vacation in Montana.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:06:13.579
    | text      = And then I go out of the studio and he had to drop some stuff off.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:06:18.579
    | text      = I forgot at his house this weekend. I was over there for my grandmother's birthday.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:06:24.579
    | text      = And so I drug my dad in here. Now he didn't want to be on camera.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:06:33.579

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:06:38.579
    | text      = I thought he'd never given it up. Wasn't that the height of like Bam Margera's popularity?

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:12.579

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
